title: Interstellar
description: As Earth's crops fail, a former pilot leaves his children to lead a crew through a wormhole in search of a habitable planet. A sweeping space odyssey about time dilation, sacrifice and the love between a father and daughter.

title: The Matrix
description: A hacker discovers that everyday reality is a computer simulation built by machines to enslave humanity, and joins a rebel crew fighting back. Slow-motion gunfights, kung fu and philosophy about free will and what is real.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: A replicant detective in a rain-soaked, neon-lit future uncovers a buried secret that could upend society. A slow, melancholy meditation on memory, identity and what it means to be human.

title: Arrival
description: When mysterious alien ships land around the world, a linguist races to decode their language before nations turn to war. A quiet, cerebral first-contact story about communication, grief and the nature of time.

title: Ex Machina
description: A young programmer is invited to a reclusive tech CEO's remote estate to test whether a humanoid robot has true consciousness. A tense, claustrophobic chamber piece about artificial intelligence, manipulation and control.

title: Inception
description: A thief who steals secrets from people's dreams is offered a chance at redemption: plant an idea in a target's mind. A layered heist through collapsing dreamscapes where time bends and reality blurs.

title: The Martian
description: Stranded alone on Mars after his crew presumes him dead, an astronaut botanist uses science, ingenuity and gallows humor to survive until rescue. An optimistic survival story about problem solving.

title: Gravity
description: After debris destroys their shuttle, a medical engineer and a veteran astronaut drift through orbit trying to reach safety. A breathless, nearly real-time survival thriller set in the silence of space.

title: Dune
description: The heir of a noble house is thrust into a deadly struggle for control of a desert planet that produces the universe's most valuable resource. Epic political intrigue, giant sandworms and prophetic visions.

title: Her
description: A lonely writer in near-future Los Angeles falls in love with an intelligent operating system with a warm voice. A tender, bittersweet romance about intimacy, loneliness and technology.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A cowardly officer thrown into battle against an alien invasion finds himself reliving the same day every time he dies. A witty time-loop war movie where each death makes him a better soldier.

title: Moon
description: Near the end of a lonely three-year contract mining helium on the far side of the moon, a worker makes a discovery that shatters his sense of self. A small, haunting story about isolation and identity.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
description: From the dawn of man to a voyage toward Jupiter, mysterious black monoliths guide human evolution while a calm ship computer turns against its crew. A visionary, hypnotic epic about technology and transcendence.

title: Alien
description: The crew of a commercial space freighter answer a distress signal and bring aboard a deadly creature that hunts them one by one. Claustrophobic corridors, dread and one of cinema's most terrifying monsters.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a desert wasteland, a warrior rebels against a tyrant and flees with his captive wives in a war rig, with a drifter along for the ride. A relentless, explosive two-hour car chase.

title: John Wick
description: A retired hitman comes out of retirement to hunt the gangsters who killed the puppy his late wife left him. Stylish, brutally choreographed gun-fu inside a secret underworld of assassins.

title: Die Hard
description: An off-duty New York cop is trapped in a Los Angeles skyscraper when terrorists take hostages at a Christmas party. Barefoot and outgunned, he fights back floor by floor with wisecracks and grit.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, an anarchic criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham into chaos and tests the hero's moral limits. A dark crime epic about order, chaos and the cost of heroism.

title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
description: A secret agent and his team race against time after a mission goes wrong and stolen plutonium threatens the world. Death-defying stunts, helicopter chases and spy double-crosses across Paris and Kashmir.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
description: A veteran navy test pilot returns to train a group of young graduates for a nearly impossible bombing mission. Thrilling real aerial dogfights mixed with grief, mentorship and redemption.

title: Gladiator
description: A Roman general betrayed by the emperor's son is sold into slavery and rises as a gladiator seeking vengeance in the Colosseum. A grand historical epic of honor, revenge and grief.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
description: A former assassin wakes from a coma and sets out to take bloody revenge on the gang who betrayed her at her wedding. A stylized samurai and martial arts revenge saga soaked in pop culture.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: An archaeologist and adventurer races against Nazi agents to find the legendary Ark of the Covenant. Booby-trapped temples, whip-cracking escapes and old-school pulp serial thrills.

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: In Regency England, a sharp-witted young woman clashes with a proud, wealthy gentleman as her mother schemes to marry off her daughters. A romantic period drama of misjudgment, class and slowly growing love.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall in love in Los Angeles while chasing their dreams. A colorful modern musical about ambition, sacrifice and the road not taken.

title: Before Sunrise
description: A young American and a French student meet on a train and spend one night walking and talking through Vienna. A gentle, dialogue-driven romance about connection, chance and fleeting time.

title: The Notebook
description: An elderly man reads a love story to a woman in a nursing home: the tale of a poor young man and a rich girl who fell for each other one summer. A sweeping, tearjerking story of lifelong love.

title: Titanic
description: A young aristocrat falls for a penniless artist aboard the doomed ocean liner on its maiden voyage. An epic romance set against class divisions and one of history's great disasters.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
description: After a painful breakup, a man undergoes a procedure to erase his ex-girlfriend from his memory, then fights to hold on to her as the memories vanish. A surreal, heartbreaking love story.

title: Notting Hill
description: A shy London bookshop owner's life turns upside down when the world's most famous movie star walks into his shop. A charming, gently funny romantic comedy about fame and ordinary life.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Over twelve years of chance meetings in New York, two friends argue about whether men and women can ever just be friends. A witty, talky romantic comedy about friendship turning into love.

title: Past Lives
description: Two childhood sweethearts separated when one family emigrates from Seoul reconnect decades later in New York. A quiet, aching drama about fate, roads not taken and the people we used to be.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
description: A New York economics professor travels to Singapore with her boyfriend and discovers his family is extraordinarily wealthy and disapproving. A glamorous, funny romantic comedy about family and belonging.

title: About Time
description: A young man learns that the men in his family can travel back in time within their own lives, and uses the gift to win the woman he loves. A warm, funny and moving story about love and appreciating ordinary days.

title: Get Out
description: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family estate for the weekend, where unsettling behavior hides something sinister. A sharp social horror film about racism, hypnosis and control.

title: Hereditary
description: After the death of a secretive grandmother, a grieving family begins to unravel as terrifying secrets about their ancestry emerge. A deeply disturbing horror about grief, trauma and the occult.

title: The Shining
description: A writer takes a job as winter caretaker of an isolated mountain hotel with his wife and psychic son, and slowly descends into murderous madness. Haunted corridors and creeping psychological horror.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family lives in near silence on a farm, hiding from blind creatures that hunt by sound. A tense survival horror about parenthood where a single noise means death.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their secluded farmhouse. A classic haunted house film full of jump scares, demonic possession and exorcism.

title: It Follows
description: After a sexual encounter, a teenager is stalked by a slow, shape-shifting entity that only she can see and that never stops walking toward her. Dreamy, paranoid suburban horror.

title: The Babadook
description: A widowed single mother and her troubled son are haunted by a sinister creature from a mysterious pop-up book. A psychological horror about grief, depression and motherhood.

title: Midsommar
description: A grieving young woman travels with her distant boyfriend to a midsummer festival in rural Sweden that turns into a pagan cult's nightmare. Sunlit, folk horror about breakups and belonging.

title: Train to Busan
description: A workaholic father and his young daughter board a high-speed train just as a zombie outbreak sweeps across South Korea. A fast, emotional zombie survival thriller about selfishness and sacrifice.

title: The Exorcist
description: When a twelve-year-old girl is possessed by a demon, her desperate mother turns to two priests to perform an exorcism. A landmark supernatural horror about faith, evil and possession.

title: Superbad
description: Two awkward high school best friends try to score alcohol for a party on their last weeks before graduation, leading to a night of chaos. A raunchy teen comedy about friendship and growing up.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A legendary hotel concierge and his loyal lobby boy are caught up in the theft of a priceless painting and a family fortune. A whimsical, symmetrical caper full of deadpan humor.

title: Groundhog Day
description: A cynical TV weatherman covering a small-town festival finds himself reliving the same day over and over. A clever, warm comedy about self-improvement and finding meaning.

title: Hot Fuzz
description: A top London cop is transferred to a sleepy English village where a series of grisly accidents may be murders. A fast-paced parody of buddy cop action movies.

title: The Big Lebowski
description: A laid-back bowling slacker is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and dragged into a bungled kidnapping scheme. A shaggy, absurd cult comedy.

title: Bridesmaids
description: A woman whose life is falling apart competes with her best friend's glamorous new friend while serving as maid of honor. A raucous comedy about friendship, jealousy and wedding disasters.

title: Paddington 2
description: A polite, marmalade-loving bear is wrongly jailed for stealing a rare pop-up book and must clear his name. A gentle, delightful family comedy about kindness.

title: Knives Out
description: When a wealthy crime novelist dies after his birthday party, an eccentric detective investigates his scheming family. A twisty whodunit full of suspects, secrets and humor.

title: Jojo Rabbit
description: A lonely boy in Nazi Germany, whose imaginary friend is a buffoonish Hitler, discovers his mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their attic. An anti-hate satire that is both funny and heartbreaking.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Two friends search for their long-lost college companion, remembering how he challenged the rote-learning pressure of India's top engineering college. A funny, emotional story about education, friendship and following your passion.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
description: Three childhood friends take a bachelor road trip across Spain, each facing a fear through an adventure sport. A breezy, sunlit film about friendship, love and living in the moment.

title: Queen
description: After her fiance calls off the wedding, a sheltered young woman from Delhi goes alone on her honeymoon to Paris and Amsterdam. A joyful coming-of-age comedy about independence and self-discovery.

title: Dil Chahta Hai
description: Three close college friends drift apart as they grow up and fall in love in very different ways. A stylish, funny coming-of-age story about friendship and modern urban romance.

title: Andhadhun
description: A pianist who pretends to be blind accidentally witnesses a murder and gets caught in a web of lies and double-crosses. A darkly comic thriller with constant twists.

title: Drishyam
description: A cable TV operator obsessed with films uses everything he has learned from cinema to protect his family after his daughter is involved in a crime. A clever cat-and-mouse thriller with police.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
description: A young man raised by villagers climbs a giant waterfall and discovers he is heir to the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, ruled by a tyrant. A larger-than-life mythic war epic.

title: RRR
description: In 1920s colonial India, two revolutionaries with opposing missions form a deep friendship. A maximalist action spectacle with tigers, bridges, dance battles and rebellion against the British Raj.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler in rural Haryana trains his two daughters to become world-class wrestlers against village prejudice. An inspiring sports drama about determination, fathers and gender equality.

title: Lagaan
description: In a drought-stricken Indian village under British rule, farmers accept a cricket match wager to escape crippling taxes. A rousing sports epic about unity and underdogs.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker wrongly convicted of murder forms a lifelong friendship with a fellow inmate over two decades in a brutal prison. A hopeful story about patience, dignity and freedom.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ unwittingly takes part in defining moments of American history while longing for his childhood sweetheart. A sentimental, sweeping life story.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family schemes its way into working for a wealthy household, until an unexpected discovery turns things violent. A darkly funny, shocking thriller about class inequality.

title: Whiplash
description: An ambitious young jazz drummer enrolls at an elite music conservatory and is pushed to the edge by an abusive, perfectionist instructor. An intense drama about obsession and greatness.

title: The Social Network
description: A Harvard student creates a social networking site that makes him a billionaire, while lawsuits from former friends and partners pile up. A sharp drama about ambition, betrayal and loneliness.

title: Good Will Hunting
description: A troubled janitor at MIT who is a secret mathematical genius works with a therapist to confront his past. A heartfelt drama about talent, trauma and friendship.

title: 12 Angry Men
description: A jury of twelve men deliberates the fate of a teenager accused of murder, as one juror's doubt slowly sways the room. A gripping single-room courtroom drama about justice and prejudice.

title: Moonlight
description: Across three chapters of his life in Miami, a young Black man struggles with identity, sexuality and masculinity. A tender, poetic coming-of-age drama.

title: Schindler's List
description: A German businessman saves more than a thousand Jewish refugees during the Holocaust by employing them in his factories. A harrowing black-and-white historical drama about courage and humanity.

title: Se7en
description: Two detectives, a weary veteran and a hot-headed rookie, hunt a serial killer who stages murders based on the seven deadly sins. A grim, rain-drenched noir thriller.

title: Gone Girl
description: When a woman disappears on her fifth wedding anniversary, media frenzy and suspicion fall on her husband. A twisted psychological thriller about marriage and manipulation.

title: Prisoners
description: When his young daughter and her friend go missing, a desperate father takes matters into his own hands while a detective follows the case. A dark, morally complex abduction thriller.

title: Memento
description: A man who cannot form new memories hunts his wife's killer using notes, photographs and tattoos. A puzzle-box thriller told in reverse order.

title: Shutter Island
description: In 1954, a U.S. Marshal investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane on a remote island. A paranoid psychological thriller full of twists.

title: Zodiac
description: A cartoonist, a reporter and a detective become obsessed with identifying the Zodiac serial killer terrorizing San Francisco. A meticulous procedural about obsession and unanswered questions.

title: No Country for Old Men
description: A hunter stumbles on a drug deal gone wrong and takes the money, setting a relentless killer on his trail across Texas. A tense, bleak neo-western thriller.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
description: An FBI trainee seeks the help of an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to catch another serial killer. A chilling psychological thriller.

title: Nightcrawler
description: A driven, amoral loner starts filming crimes and accidents at night in Los Angeles to sell the footage to TV news. A dark satire of ambition and sensational media.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an Italian-American mafia family transfers control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son. An operatic crime saga about family, loyalty and power.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: The interlocking stories of two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers unfold out of order in Los Angeles. Witty dialogue, violence and dark humor.

title: Goodfellas
description: A young man rises through the ranks of the New York mob alongside his volatile friends, until paranoia and drugs bring it all down. A kinetic, true-story gangster epic.

title: Heat
description: An obsessive LAPD detective pursues a disciplined professional thief planning one last big score. A sprawling cops-and-robbers epic with a legendary downtown shootout.

title: The Departed
description: An undercover cop infiltrates the Boston Irish mob while a mob mole rises in the police department, and each tries to expose the other. A tense crime thriller about loyalty and deception.

title: Ocean's Eleven
description: A charming ex-con assembles a team of specialists to rob three Las Vegas casinos at once. A slick, playful heist movie.

title: Spirited Away
description: A sullen ten-year-old girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse for gods to save her parents, who were turned into pigs. A magical, imaginative animated fairy tale.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a flashy new space ranger action figure becomes his owner's favorite toy. A funny, heartfelt animated buddy adventure.

title: Up
description: A grumpy elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house to fly to South America, with a young wilderness scout accidentally along. A moving animated adventure about grief and new beginnings.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
description: Brooklyn teen Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and teams up with spider heroes from other dimensions. A bold, comic-book animated superhero story.

title: WALL-E
description: On an abandoned, trash-covered Earth, a lonely waste-collecting robot falls in love with a sleek probe and follows her into space. A nearly wordless animated love story with an environmental message.

title: Coco
description: A Mexican boy who dreams of becoming a musician is transported to the colorful Land of the Dead on Día de Muertos. A vibrant animated story about family, memory and music.

title: Inside Out
description: Inside the mind of an eleven-year-old girl, her personified emotions Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust struggle to guide her through a difficult move. A clever animated film about feelings.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
description: Two young sisters move to the countryside and befriend gentle forest spirits, including a giant fluffy creature. A soothing, whimsical animated film about childhood wonder.

title: Your Name
description: A city boy and a country girl mysteriously begin swapping bodies in their sleep and form a bond across distance and time. A gorgeous animated romance with a comet and a twist.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A humble hobbit inherits a powerful ring and sets out with a fellowship of companions to destroy it before the dark lord reclaims it. An epic fantasy quest across Middle-earth.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
description: In his third year at Hogwarts, a young wizard learns that a dangerous escaped prisoner may be hunting him. A darker magical adventure with time travel and soul-sucking guards.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
description: In post-civil war Spain, a girl living with her cruel stepfather escapes into a dark fairy-tale world guided by a mysterious faun. A beautiful and violent fable for adults.

title: The Princess Bride
description: A grandfather reads his sick grandson a tale of a farm boy turned pirate who must rescue his true love from an evil prince. Swordfights, giants and true love in a witty fairy tale.

title: Jurassic Park
description: During a preview tour, a theme park of cloned dinosaurs suffers a power failure and the animals break loose. A thrilling adventure about science and nature.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
description: A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to rescue a governor's daughter from cursed undead pirates. A swashbuckling, funny high-seas adventure.

title: The Shape of Water
description: At a secret Cold War government lab, a mute cleaning woman forms a bond with a captured amphibious creature. A dreamy, unconventional fairy-tale romance about outsiders.

title: Rear Window
description: A photographer confined to his apartment with a broken leg spies on his neighbors and becomes convinced one of them committed murder. A suspense classic about voyeurism.

title: Vertigo
description: A retired detective with a fear of heights is hired to follow an old friend's wife and becomes obsessed with her. A haunting psychological thriller about obsession and identity.
